title: History record projection
responsibility: Builds the display form of a verification record with resolved media and explicit inherited evidence origins.

inputs.name: recordView.record
inputs.description: Complete verification record to project. The function returns its identity, status, source, profile ID, timestamps, gates, failures, measurements, budgets, and reason status/missing fields; tests and scenarios are reshaped for display. Builds are included only when present. Repository, tools, components, impact, and other unprojected fields are omitted.

inputs.name: recordView.context
inputs.type: { valid: boolean; problems: string[]; resolve: MediaResolver; /** The checks an earlier record ran, by its id; undefined when it cannot be read. */ origins?: (record: string) => DiagnosticTest[] | undefined; }
inputs.description: Caller-supplied validity and problems plus capture and origin resolvers. resolve(capture, origin) runs for every capture and its media/gap result is merged into that capture. For referenced scenarios, origins(origin) supplies tests; only IDs beginning with the scenario ID plus a colon are kept. If no origin list is returned, originTests is omitted; fresh scenarios do not call origins.

outputs.name: recordView
outputs.description: History display projection with identity, status, validity, problems, source, profile ID, timestamps, gates, failures, measurements, budgets, and only reason status/missing fields. Tests keep ID, kind, target, status, duration, and browser errors when present. Scenarios include their actual record and commit origin, states, resolved capture media/gaps, and available scoped origin tests. Builds appear only when the record declares them.
